motion.phase_rule: If movement input flag is zero and instance vcall88 returns0: phase=0, origin=now. Otherwise phase=unsigned32(now-origin)//50. Unit of the supplied timestamp is not independently established here.
motion.table_rule: Signed DWORD table of2048 entries from original PE; min=-65536,max=65536. Use exact table values, not recomputed floating sine.
motion.index_rule: p=low32(runtimeCycle*phase); W=((low32(p<<7)>>2)&2047); O=((low32(p<<8)>>2)&2047). All SHR logical.
motion.input_waddle: trunc_zero(trunc_zero(s32(low32(table[W]*rawWaddle))/512)/4096); add modulo2^32 to local input DWORD.
motion.action80_waddle: trunc_zero(trunc_zero(s32(low32(table[W]*rawWaddle))/4096)/4096); first DWORD of action80, next two DWORDs0, followed by action type and player tag.
motion.oscillate: trunc_zero(trunc_zero(s32(low32(table[O]*rawOscillate))/128)/4096). If local half flag!=0: trunc_zero(result/2). Add modulo2^32 to local DWORD.
motion.overflow: Signed32 low product is used before division. No game clamp to native editor0..1 or cycle1..12 in these fragments.
motion.gates: The input-waddle addition requires changed phase, vcall88==0 and nonzero Waddle. The complete function has additional creature status, input and terrain conditions. These are not modeled as a complete input controller.
motion.scope: Exact arithmetic and action80 construction only. Local coordinate interpretation and camera action80 handler/rendering are not newly established.

sniper.multiplier_gate: integerFactor>1, equivalent to raw>=8192. Applies before both activate AND deactivate branches.
sniper.slots: Examine indices0,1,2 in order. Getter returns runtime+5E1+19*i only if i<runtimeByte789, otherwise initialized zero slot. First availableLevel<=instanceByte403 and nonzero spellId wins. No eligible slot -> no commands, even if SniperMode was already set.

raw_slot_layout.delay_transform: uint32(rawShotDelay * simulationTPS) >> 12 in the inspected loader; intermediate product wraps32 bits
raw_slot_layout.warning: Exactly3 physical slots in the measured variants. Increasing catalogue record count does not add a fourth creature spell slot. Keep unused IDs/unknown bytes and slot order.

sniper.lookup: Calls world vtableE8 with selected spellId; return value is ignored. This body does not require a successful spell-definition lookup.
sniper.camera_base: Native bridge vtableD0 returns bridge+3E5 (camera); base DWORD is camera+1D8, i.e. bridge+5BD. It is inside camera configuration mode2 at subrecord+80 according to the source layout. Its physical unit is not established by this result.
sniper.packet: Three payload DWORDs at0/4/8; type DWORD+C; player tag WORD+10. Actions are queued; no camera-rendering effect or time unit for300 is claimed here.

flag_handler.rule: If player+134 possessed tag !=0: state=(state &7FFFFFFF)|((actionValue &1)<<31). Otherwise unchanged. All other bits preserved.

registration.scope: Original initializer associates type27 with handler5171D0 in one action record; complete dispatch lifecycle is outside this projection.

native_editor: Previously documented Q12 display/writer for SniperZoomMultiplier; Waddle/Oscillate values>1 reset0 on native model callback, WalkCycle>12 resets4. Independent serialization should preserve original raw values, not silently run the editor projection.
limitations: Exact inspected executable hashes; no live-game input, camera rendering or complete GUI run.

Motion emulations enter arithmetic fragments after caller gates. Sniper emulations skip caller/player resolution and SEH prologue, then run original threshold/slot selection, getter, empty world lookup and camera getter; queued packets are captured in emulator memory.
The supplied native slot-getter initialization flag is1 and its fallback is zero, matching the initialized state; first-time initialization/atexit registration is outside the emulation.
No pixel zoom ratio, FOV units, actionE duration unit or full first-person control behavior is inferred from the packet producer alone.
